videos.title: The spelled-out intro to neural networks and backpropagation: building micrograd
videos.why: A careful, code-first explanation of how a small network learns. Watch after Python basics; pause often and run the code.

videos.title: Transformers, the tech behind LLMs, explained visually
videos.why: Visual intuition for attention and transformer blocks before the code-heavy lessons.

videos.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out
videos.why: Build a tiny GPT from data preparation through attention and text generation; do it in short sessions.

videos.title: [1hr Talk] Intro to Large Language Models
videos.why: A strong high-level map of what an LLM is, how it is trained, and how to use it.

videos.title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
videos.why: Long-form, detailed walk-through of modern LLM training and inference. Save this for after the one-hour introduction.

videos.title: Learn RAG From Scratch – Python AI Tutorial from a LangChain Engineer
videos.why: A practical multi-part RAG course: indexing, retrieval, generation and improvements. Build alongside it.

videos.title: Building Agents with Model Context Protocol — Full Workshop
videos.why: Hands-on MCP workshop from an Anthropic engineer; watch after you understand a basic tool-calling loop.

videos.title: Introduction to Deep Reinforcement Learning
videos.why: Walks through the Hugging Face deep-RL course and a first agent; optional branch after basic ML.

videos.title: QLoRA in Action: A Fine-Tuning Tutorial
videos.why: A step-by-step practical QLoRA notebook. Treat it as a guided lab, not proof that fine-tuning is always needed.

videos.title: LLM Engineering Roadmap 2026: from LLMs to production AI agents
videos.why: A broad orientation video; use it to see the landscape, then follow the structured path rather than hopping between topics.

playlists.title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
playlists.why: The strongest code-first backbone in this list: micrograd, makemore, backprop, WaveNet and GPT. Use the early lessons; later ones are intentionally challenging.

playlists.title: Neural networks (visual series)
playlists.why: Animated intuition for neural networks, gradient descent and backprop. No need to work through algebra; focus on the pictures and explanations.

playlists.title: Hugging Face Course
playlists.why: An official 80-video series covering Transformers, tokenizers, datasets, fine-tuning and the Hugging Face ecosystem.

playlists.title: Stanford CME295: Transformers and Large Language Models
playlists.why: A university-level deeper track. Return to it after the visual and code-first introductions; skip any derivation-heavy parts that do not serve your project.

playlists.title: Hugging Face AI Agents video series
playlists.why: A practical series on building agents with Smolagents and other tools. Pair it with the free Agents Course text lessons and build each example yourself.

playlists.title: RAG From Scratch
playlists.why: Short lessons that build retrieval-augmented generation one component at a time.

playlists.title: Machine Learning
playlists.why: A visual, carefully sequenced machine-learning playlist. Watch the explanations, then reproduce each concept with scikit-learn; skip equations that are not useful to your project.

playlists.title: Andrej Karpathy — general-audience LLM videos
playlists.why: For understanding LLMs without starting in code. Watch the one-hour intro before the full deep dive.
